caption: Explosive Blow
lines: Drag an unequipped weapon of grade 40 or higher from your inventory into the blacksmith weapon slot.
The window shows its Explosive Blow level, current cap, success chance and required Stones of Revision.
Use Revise to spend Stones of Revision on improving the success chance. Use Explosive Blow to attempt the next level for a Geon fee.
Check the displayed chance before upgrading: a failed attempt can destroy the weapon.
To obtain Stones of Revision, use a Revision Hammer on eligible equipment in your inventory.
